panels.description: In a civic archive, Leona stands among old records while Ada stops several steps away. Keep the upper archive clear.
Leona opens a stone-grey box containing a sage-gold Covenant band. Keep the upper box clear.
Leona looks at a child's object inside the box while Ada remains guarded. Keep the upper box area clear.
Ada and Leona face one another across the archive table. Keep the upper table clear.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I knew where you were within a year.

items.speaker: ADA
items.text: Then you knew enough to come.

items.speaker: LEONA
items.text: I believed you were safer not knowing I was looking.
